races.paceDynamic: Amina will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners, creating a steady but uncontested gallop through the early stages. In The Trenches may take a prominent position but won't pressure the leader aggressively. The large field of hold-up horses including Allroadsleadtorome, Colwyn Bay, and Jet Renegade will create a traffic-heavy finish as they all seek room to mount challenges. This pace scenario strongly favours horses that can settle close enough to avoid the late scramble while having the pace to strike decisively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Amina gets an easy lead and quickens decisively from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The mare will have too much in reserve after the comfortable gallop, with the hold-up horses struggling to close the gap in time. Her previous placed efforts suggest she can capitalize when getting things her own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If In The Trenches or another prominent runner can get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest enough to set up a perfectly-timed challenge from just behind the leader, avoiding the late traffic problems. Horses that can position prominently will have the tactical edge over those relying on late runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one of the closers finds a clear passage
scenarios.body: A patient ride will pay dividends if the early gallop is too slow and the field bunches up for a sprint finish. The best of the hold-up horses can still prevail despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed horses shows significant improvement from their debut
scenarios.body: The step up in trip or experience will unlock untapped potential in horses like Mydreamtell or Western Shores. Their lack of exposed form becomes an advantage if they've improved significantly at home.

watchPoints.text: Amina must be monitored early to see if she gets the uncontested lead as expected
In The Trenches positioning crucial as only realistic pace challenger to the leader
Traffic problems likely in straight with 16 hold-up horses needing room simultaneously
Western Shores and Mydreamtell market moves could signal yard confidence in improvement
Jockey tactics on Euro Agent will reveal intended running style and realistic chances

races.paceDynamic: She's A Fine Wine will lead from the outset with no obvious challengers for the early pace, creating a sustainable gallop rather than a fierce tempo. The prominent runners Long Gone, Hillhead Runner, Tir Og and Radar Ahead will track the leader in the second rank, while the hold-up brigade including Hasten Slowly, Miss Manzor and Rockstown Girl will need the pace to collapse late. With only one confirmed front runner and multiple prominent types happy to sit behind, this sets up as a moderate pace that will quicken from the home turn. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and have the tactical speed to strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If She's A Fine Wine sets a steady tempo without pressure from behind...
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader before quickening from the home turn when the hold-up horses have too much to do. Long Gone and Hillhead Runner are ideally positioned to strike in the straight with their higher ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finish Benefits Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the straight and becomes a sprint finish...
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with plenty left in the tank for a late surge. Hasten Slowly and Miss Manzor can unleash their finishing kicks when the early pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If She's A Fine Wine gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home...
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows her to dictate terms completely and build an unassailable advantage. Her class advantage at OR 119 tells when given these ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace becomes stop-start with multiple moves throughout the race...
scenarios.body: The tactical nature plays into the hands of unexposed or improving types who can handle the changing rhythms. Gangster Granny and You Make Me Smile can capitalize on the chaos with their recent good form.

watchPoints.text: She's A Fine Wine showing any signs of rust early given her 245-day absence could derail her class advantage
Long Gone and Hillhead Runner settling kindly behind the leader as their positioning will be crucial to their chances
Hasten Slowly getting a strong enough pace to aim at given the likely moderate gallop may not suit her hold-up style
Radar Ahead and Wild Mandate showing any sharpness early after their respective long layoffs
The pace through the first mile as a moderate tempo strongly favours the prominent runners over the hold-up brigade

races.paceDynamic: Chanceawetmorning will take up the running from the start without serious pressure, as most of the field prefer to sit off the pace. Red Glory, Mr Master Mac, Cloonainra and Malbay Madness will track in behind but none are confirmed front-runners. The lack of genuine pace-pressers means Chanceawetmorning can dictate a steady rhythm through the early stages before quickening. This sustainable tempo strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed, while making life difficult for the many hold-up horses who need a strong gallop to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Chanceawetmorning gets an easy lead with Red Glory and Mr Master Mac tracking but not pressuring early.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too steady for the hold-up brigade to close effectively, allowing the prominent runners to kick clear when the tempo lifts approaching the home turn. Chanceawetmorning and the early stalkers have too much in hand over the backmarkers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Creates Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Red Glory or Mr Master Mac move up to challenge Chanceawetmorning before the home turn.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and brings the hold-up horses into play, particularly those with proven finishing kicks. Arch Empire and Kamino Bello benefit from the stronger tempo to close from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If the field stays bunched turning for home with multiple horses still in contention.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure ability rather than tactics, favouring the highest-rated horses regardless of running style. Red Glory's class tells despite the long absence while Chanceawetmorning holds on grimly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock from Backmarkers
scenarios.trigger: If Chanceawetmorning sets a genuinely strong pace from the start under pressure.
scenarios.body: The early leaders weaken dramatically in the final furlong, allowing a late closer to pick up the pieces. Dontgowithjoe or Metamorpheus emerge from the pack to capitalize on the collapse up front.

watchPoints.text: Chanceawetmorning gets too easy a lead early and kicks clear turning for home before the hold-up horses can respond.
Red Glory travels strongly despite the long break, suggesting De Bromhead has him ready to run a big race fresh.
Mr Master Mac races too keenly in the prominent position and fails to see out the trip under pressure.
Arch Empire gets a good position early instead of being held up, indicating connections expect a steady pace.
The pace through the first mile is genuine rather than steady, bringing the backmarkers into serious contention.

races.paceDynamic: Beat The Devil will establish the lead unchallenged from the flag, with his natural front-running style and highest OR of 120 making him the logical pacesetter. Lumiere Du Large, Butch Coolidge, Maxwell Smart and Pure Logic will track prominently behind, creating a genuine pace through the early stages. The sustained tempo will stretch the field, putting pressure on the hold-up horses Houndsworth, Fedneys Park, Sea Of Doubt and Blue Moon Boy to get into contention early. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can secure good positions early and kick from the front group.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Devil sets honest pace and prominent trackers respond
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will suit horses positioned handy who can quicken from good positions. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground against the strong pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Bolts
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Devil gets soft lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The class horse exploits weak pursuit to build unassailable advantage turning for home. His 120 OR suggests he has gears others lack when allowed easy time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If early pace collapses and becomes crawling affair
scenarios.body: Fedneys Park and Sea Of Doubt get the slow-run race they need to unleash finishing kicks. The patient tactics pay dividends in sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If interference or jumping errors disrupt the market leaders
scenarios.body: Blue Moon Boy or Annie's Angel capitalize on others' misfortune with clear runs. Weight advantages and fresh conditions help unfancied runners.

watchPoints.text: Beat The Devil's jumping after 222-day absence - any early mistake will destroy front-running tactics
Maxwell Smart's fitness after 57-day gap - previous form shows he needs regular runs to stay sharp
Fedneys Park's early positioning - hold-up horse who fades late needs to be closer than usual
Pure Logic's jumping rhythm - recent falls suggest confidence issues that could resurface under pressure
Sea Of Doubt's early movement - needs to track the pace closer than usual given strong early gallop expected

races.paceDynamic: Oh So Charming will dictate terms from the front with minimal pressure, as no other confirmed front-runners appear in this 17-runner field. Walk Win, Demanding Gerry, Spanish John, Centaq and Georginas Jet will track the pace in prominent positions, but the early fractions should be comfortable. The large field will create a strung-out affair with many hold-up horses needing luck in running. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers who can position close to Oh So Charming and strike turning for home, rather than the numerous hold-up horses who face traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Striker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Oh So Charming sets uncontested fractions and the field strings out normally
scenarios.body: The pace-tracker gets first run on the leader and has enough in reserve to repel late challengers. Hold-up horses struggle with positioning and the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Oh So Charming gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage as chasers commit too late on the testing climb. Prominent horses get closest but fall short of catching the winner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the field bunches approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: A traffic-free hold-up horse with superior finishing kick exploits the slow tempo. The front division ties up as fresher legs emerge from the pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Longshot
scenarios.trigger: If Oh So Charming stops quickly or multiple fallers create interference
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with several fancied runners compromised by trouble. An unfancied runner with a clear passage capitalizes on the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Oh So Charming getting harassed early would completely change the race dynamics and open it up for closers

High Notions needs a clear run from the back but has the class to win if getting racing room
The large field size creates significant potential for traffic problems affecting multiple hold-up horses
Demanding Gerry's consistent prominent style makes him the most reliable each-way option
